title: rubus vulgaris var. silvaticus
intro: Rubus vulgaris var. silvaticus, commonly known as the woodland raspberry, is a type of wild raspberry plant that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Rubus vulgaris var. silvaticus include wound healing, anti-aging, and immune system modulation, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as ellagic acid, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents in this plant are responsible for its health benefits, including protection against oxidative stress, inflammation, and cancer.
